title: New Hamptons Style Range - Collection Federation
bodyHtml:
Curated Hamptons Style Bathroom Furnishings

Studio Bagno is excited to present a carefully curated selection of bathroom furnishings, including our brand new Impero Bath, along with stylish consoles, meticulously crafted toilets and classic inset basins.

A Classic and Cohesive Stlye Throughout the Range

The Impero Bath is crafted with meticulous attention to detail, incorporating subtle references to the classic era of bathrooms. Designed to complement our Federation Basins and Toilets, the Impero Bath serves as the quintessential centerpiece for any Federation-inspired bathroom. It effortlessly merges traditional styling with modern comfort and technology, offering a harmonious blend of timeless elegance and contemporary functionality.

The Impero Suite

The Impero 50 Inset Basin

Every piece within the Collection is meticulously crafted to harmoniously marry the timeless allure of yesteryears, with the exceptional functionality and quality that Studio Bagno is celebrated for.
